title: Titan X Fruit Punch Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Fruit Punch is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This handy refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, offering extended use and easy setup. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to vape. The Fruit Punch flavour is a vibrant fusion of tropical fruits, delivering a burst of sweet and tangy notes with every puff. Juicy and uplifting, this well-rounded flavour captures the lively essence of a tropical fruit medley, balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Complete with a pre-installed mesh coil for enhanced flavour and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit pairs perfectly with the Titan X device’s auto-refill system to provide up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent), ensuring a reliable, flavour-rich vaping experience.
